# SubjectLog schemas
{: .no_toc}

Entry schemas for subject logs: measurements and observations followed over time for one subject.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`subjectlog`](/api/modules/subjectlog/): `type` selects the type; each log entry added through the entry actions is validated against it.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Consumption Logs

### Food consumption log

- type code `FoodConsumption` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/FoodConsumption/1.1.1.json)

Logs the amount of food a subject consumed, for tracking intake over time, for example during food restriction.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `foodAmount` | Food amount | quantity with unit | yes | units `kg`, `g`, `mg`, `µg`; default `{"unit": "g"}` | Food amount consumed. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "foodAmount": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "g"
    }
}
```

- type code `WaterConsumption` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/WaterConsumption/1.1.1.json)

## Genetic Logs

### Genotyping log

- type code `Genotyping` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/Genotyping/1.0.2.json)

Logs a genotyping result for the subject, with the interpreted genotype, the sample used, assay or panel, confidence and per-locus calls.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `result` | Genotype result | text | yes |  | Overall interpreted genotype for this subject (e.g., 'PV-Cre/wt; Ai32/wt; Sex: F' or 'Negative for PV-Cre'). |
| `sample` | Sample | text | yes |  | Describe the biological sample used for the genotyping assay, including type and location (e.g., tail snip, ear punch, blood sample). |
| `assayPanel` | Assay / panel name | text |  |  | Which PCR/qPCR panel or service was used. |
| `qcConfidence` | QC / confidence | choice |  | one of `high`, `medium`, `low`, `ambiguous`, `failed` | Confidence or quality of the genotyping result. |
| `lociResults` | Per-locus calls | table of rows |  | format table | Per-locus genotype calls reported for this genotyping event. |
| `lociResults[].marker` | Marker / transgene / allele | text | yes |  | The marker, transgene, or allele tested at this locus. |
| `lociResults[].call` | Call | text | yes |  | The reported genotype call for this marker or locus. |
| `lociResults[].notes` | Notes | text |  | default `""` | A concise qualification of this locus-level genotype call. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "result": "text",
    "sample": "text",
    "assayPanel": "text",
    "qcConfidence": "high"
}
```

## Observation Logs

### Generic observation

- type code `GenericObservation` · version 2.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/GenericObservation/2.0.1.json)

Logs a behavioral or other observation that no specific log type covers, with its category, a description and the number of repetitions.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `observationType` | Observation type | choice | yes | one of `pain_score`, `grooming`, `exploration`, `freezing`, `facial_expression`, `unusual_behavior`, `other` | The category or behavioral domain of the observation. |
| `observation` | Observation | text | yes |  | Description of the observed behavior. |
| `repetitions` | Repetitions | integer |  | ≥ 1; default `1` | How many times this observation was recorded under the same condition. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "observationType": "pain_score",
    "observation": "text",
    "repetitions": 1
}
```


### Hargreaves thermal sensitivity test

- type code `HargreavesTest` · version 2.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/HargreavesTest/2.0.2.json)

Logs Hargreaves tests of thermal sensitivity, with stimulus location, paw withdrawal latency, cutoff latency, a 0 to 3 response score and the number of trials.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `stimulusLocation` | Stimulus location | choice | yes | one of `left_hind_paw`, `right_hind_paw`, `left_forepaw`, `right_forepaw`, `left_face`, `right_face`, `tail`, `other` | Anatomical location where the thermal stimulus was applied using the Hargreaves test. |
| `latency` | Withdrawal latency | quantity with unit | yes | units `µs`, `ms`, `s`, `min`, `h`; default `{"unit": "s"}` | Time from stimulus onset to paw withdrawal. |
| `cutoffLatency` | Cutoff latency | quantity with unit |  | units `µs`, `ms`, `s`, `min`, `h`; default `{"unit": "s"}` | Maximum allowable latency before automatic termination to prevent tissue damage. |
| `responseScore` | Response score (0–3) | choice | yes | one of `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`; ≥ 0 and ≤ 3 | Categorical assessment of behavioral response. 0: No response, 1: Delayed movement, 2: Normal withdrawal, 3: Exaggerated or escape behavior |
| `repetitions` | Repetitions | integer |  | ≥ 1; default `3` | Number of repeated Hargreaves trials at the given location. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "stimulusLocation": "left_hind_paw",
    "latency": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "s"
    },
    "responseScore": 0,
    "cutoffLatency": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "s"
    },
    "repetitions": 3
}
```


### Von Frey mechanical sensitivity test

- type code `VonFreyTest` · version 2.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/VonFreyTest/2.0.2.json)

Logs Von Frey tests of mechanical sensitivity, with stimulus location, filament force, a 0 to 3 response score and the number of repetitions.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `stimulusLocation` | Stimulus location | choice | yes | one of `left_hind_paw`, `right_hind_paw`, `left_forepaw`, `right_forepaw`, `left_face`, `right_face`, `tail`, `other` | Anatomical location where the Von Frey filament was applied. |
| `stimulusForce` | Stimulus force | quantity with unit | yes | units `mg`, `g`, `kg`; default `{"unit": "g"}` | Force of the Von Frey filament used for mechanical stimulation. |
| `responseScore` | Response score (0–3) | choice | yes | one of `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`; ≥ 0 and ≤ 3 | Categorical assessment of behavioral response to stimulation. 0: No response, 1: Slight movement, 2: Strong withdrawal, 3: Flinching or escape |
| `repetitions` | Repetitions | integer |  | ≥ 1; default `10` | Number of repetitions of Von Frey stimulation at the given location. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "stimulusLocation": "left_hind_paw",
    "stimulusForce": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "g"
    },
    "responseScore": 0,
    "repetitions": 10
}
```


## Physical and Health Logs

### Monitoring log

- type code `Monitoring` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/Monitoring/1.0.1.json)

Logs routine monitoring of a subject, combining body weight, food and water consumed, body condition score and general health notes.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `weight` | Weight | quantity with unit |  | units `kg`, `g`, `mg`; default `{"unit": "g"}` | Body weight of the subject. |
| `foodAmount` | Food consumed | quantity with unit |  | units `kg`, `g`, `mg`; default `{"unit": "g"}` | Amount of food consumed since last measurement. |
| `waterAmount` | Water consumed | quantity with unit |  | units `L`, `mL`, `µL`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | Amount of water consumed since last measurement. |
| `bodyConditionScore` | Body condition score (1-5) | choice |  | one of `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5` | Manual visual/palpation body condition score (Ullman-Cullere scale). Assessed by the observer independently of body weight — 1 = emaciated, 3 = ideal, 5 = obese. |
| `healthObservations` | Health observations | text (multi-line) |  |  | General health notes, appearance, and behaviour observations. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "weight": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "g"
    },
    "foodAmount": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "g"
    }
}
```

### Welfare check

- type code `WelfareCheck` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SubjectLog/WelfareCheck/1.0.2.json)

Logs a clinical welfare assessment, with abnormal signs, condition and pain scores, condition of wound or implant sites, actions taken, the monitoring plan and whether a humane endpoint was met.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `clinicalSigns` | Clinical signs | multi-select |  | one of `hunched_posture`, `poor_grooming`, `piloerection`, `discharge_or_porphyrin`, `dehydrated`, `reduced_food_water`, `reduced_mobility`, `labored_breathing`, `seizure`, `tremor`, `circling`, `ataxia`, `paresis_or_paralysis`, `head_tilt`, `self_injury`, `abnormal_vocalisation`, `other`; format select2 | Tick all abnormal clinical signs observed. Neurological or motor signs (seizure, tremor, circling, ataxia, paresis, head tilt) may be model- or procedure-related. Leave empty if none observed. |
| `actionsTaken` | Actions taken | multi-select | yes | one of `none`, `continue_monitoring`, `increase_monitoring`, `husbandry_support`, `food_or_water_support`, `clinical_treatment_given`, `analgesia_given`, `vet_notified`, `vet_assessment_requested`, `procedure_paused`, `withdrawn_from_study`, `humane_endpoint_applied`, `other`; format select2 | Select all actions taken. Treatments, analgesia, antibiotics, fluids, or euthanasia should also be recorded as linked Procedure / ProcedureEpisode entries. |
| `demeanourScore` | Condition & demeanour (0-4) | choice | yes | one of `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4` | Overall clinical condition and demeanour on the BAR/QAR scale, scored 0 (normal) to 4 (worst). This is a demeanour score, not a Body Condition Score — record body weight and body condition in the Monitoring log. • 0: Bright, alert, responsive — normal behaviour and activity. • 1: Quiet but responsive — mildly subdued, still aware and reactive. • 2: Subdued, reduced activity — noticeably less active; may show early hunching. • 3: Lethargic, reluctant to move — markedly reduced activity, hunched/isolated; indicates distress. • 4: Moribund or non-responsive — humane endpoint; record the action taken and notify the named veterinary surgeon. |
| `monitoringPlan` | Monitoring plan | text |  |  | Monitoring plan following this check (frequency and duration). |
| `painMethod` | Pain scoring method | choice |  | one of `not_assessed`, `clinical_nrs`, `mouse_grimace_scale`, `rat_grimace_scale`, `institutional_score_sheet`, `other` | Pain / distress scoring instrument used. The scale range differs between instruments (shown in each option), so the method is recorded alongside the score to keep it interpretable. Grimace scales should be scored in awake animals. |
| `painScore` | Pain score | number |  | ≥ 0 | Pain / distress score on the selected scale (e.g. 4 on a Rat Grimace Scale of 0-8). |
| `siteType` | Procedure / wound site type | choice |  | one of `not_applicable`, `surgical`, `implant`, `injection_infusion`, `sample_collection`, `other` | Kind of procedure that created the site being assessed. Categories mirror the Procedure type groups. Use 'Other' for non-procedure lesions (e.g. barbering or fight wounds). |
| `siteObservation` | Site observation | text |  |  | Condition of the wound, surgical, implant, injection, or sample-collection site. |
| `endpointCriterion` | Endpoint criterion | text |  |  | Which humane endpoint criterion was met, if any. These are protocol-defined and vary by study and species. |
| `endpointCriteriaMet` | Humane endpoint criteria met | choice | yes | one of `no`, `yes`; default `"no"` | Whether predefined humane endpoint criteria were met at this check. If 'Yes', record the criterion and the action taken. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "actionsTaken": [
        "none"
    ],
    "demeanourScore": 0,
    "endpointCriteriaMet": "no",
    "clinicalSigns": [
        "hunched_posture"
    ],
    "monitoringPlan": "text"
}
```
